cli.usage:
NinjaCode CLI — agentic coding harness

Usage:
  ninjacode run <task> [options]
  ninjacode demo
  ninjacode eval

Options:
  --workspace <path>   Workspace root (default: cwd)
  --provider <kind>    anthropic|openai|deepseek|openrouter|moonshot|glm|mistral|mammouth|openai-compatible|mock|echo|gateway
  --model <name>       Model id
  --api-key <key>      API key (or env ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY / DEEPSEEK_API_KEY)
  --base-url <url>     Custom OpenAI-compatible base URL
  --mode <mode>        agent|plan|ask|debug (default: agent)
  --approval <mode>    strict|balanced|autonomous (default: balanced)
  --lang <locale>      en|fr (default: auto from LANG / NINJACODE_LANG)
  --yes                Auto-approve all tools (sets autonomous + allowlist)
  --no-checkpoints     Disable shadow-git checkpoints
cli.missingApiKey: Missing API key. Pass --api-key or set provider env var.

cli.gateway.creditsPartial: ⚠ Answer stopped — out of credits (response above is incomplete).
cli.gateway.rateLimited: ⚠ Rate limited — the gateway throttled this key (retries already attempted).
cli.gateway.modelNotPriced: ⚠ {model} is unavailable — no active price on the gateway.
cli.gateway.accountSuspended: ⚠ Your account is suspended — contact support to restore access.
cli.gateway.unauthorized: ⚠ Session expired — sign in again to keep using NinjaCode.
cli.gateway.upstreamTimeout: ⚠ The model stopped responding — the provider went silent mid-answer.
